queries_run: Lear Corporation credit rating OR downgrade 2026 customer GM Ford Stellantis

findings.claim: 2025年GM占Lear淨銷售22%，Ford 12%，Mercedes-Benz與Volkswagen各10%，Stellantis 9%（前五大合計約63%）
findings.excerpt: In 2025, General Motors, one of the largest automotive and light truck manufacturers in the world, accounted for 22% of our net sales. In addition, Ford accounted for 12%, Mercedes-Benz and Volkswagen each accounted for 10% and Stellantis accounted for 9% of our 2025 net sales.

findings.claim: 10-K風險因子載明主要客戶產量下滑或財務困境可能損害Lear財務表現；傳統車廠（Lear最大客戶）受中國車廠擴張侵蝕市占
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: As these traditional automakers are among our largest customers, our business and financial results may be adversely affected by decreases in their businesses or market share.

findings.claim: 一次網搜未找到2026年Lear或其主要客戶的信評降級、破產或財測下修相關來源；搜尋結果中的信評行動皆為2000年代中期舊資料

customer_concentration_credit.note: 客戶自身2026信用狀況僅搜一次、未查得具體來源；不作結論。
